title: Kasturi Lal Ralia Ram Jain v. State of U.P.

content.caseIdentity: Kasturi Lal Ralia Ram Jain v. State of U.P., AIR 1965 SC 1039 (Supreme Court of India)
content.holding: Held that the State was not vicariously liable for the misappropriation of seized gold by police constables because the arrest and seizure were acts performed in the exercise of sovereign powers.
content.relevance: Traditional authority on sovereign immunity in private law torts, later circumscribed by constitutional tort jurisprudence.
